description: Second webview created only under PYLAIR_SELF_TEST_WEBVIEW. Grants emit/emitTo on purpose so the two-window event-scoping self-test proves stream/result delivery is bound to the invoking webview, not merely protected by the deny-emit stopgap. Also denies the add function for this window only, so the self-test proves per-function permissions are enforced per window (win-b must get PERMISSION_DENIED while main still succeeds). win-b never exists in a normal run.
